concept: EBS: encryption by default at account/region level
tests: How to guarantee encryption of all new EBS volumes in a region without manual action by developers.
expected: Enable EBS encryption by default in the account settings for the region — all new volumes and snapshot copies are encrypted automatically. Triggers: "by default", "without relying on developers".
why_not: A tag policy does not enforce encryption; an SCP on ec2:RunInstances just blocks launches; manual encryption — error-prone and not automatic.
